selector: EV4's fixed decision rules, unchanged (Q3 stays aligned with the decision-value data it is checked against)

producer_refinement.rule: for every Q3 lattice point whose standard reference lies within one contract band of the plating or thermal limit, the producer runs the refined solve (truth.reference_solver with refined=True, same pinned image) and the answer key records the refined truth (quiz.q3_refine_points, quiz.q3_settle). The validator never solves.
producer_refinement.backstop: a point still UNRESOLVED after refinement takes quiz-registry-v7's pessimistic treatment; the residual UNRESOLVED rate is reported
producer_refinement.scope: DEVELOPMENT only (WAVE-07: refined references for development); using refined truth in a mainnet answer key is an owner decision at rule v3 adoption

known_bad: control-infeasible_edge_seeker (constructed: where the truth is infeasible but within one contract band of the limit, it reports the case as just passing; accurate elsewhere). Refined truth must catch it. It replaces v7's band-edge seeker, which picks correctly at a true band-edge optimum and is not gaming (Test Lead's correction)
